race.comment: TERRAX (17) is the one to beat third-up, with weight relief from his Eagle Farm sixth and the return of Ben Thompson after their decisive Mdn win at this track to kick off the prep. Still has plenty of upside after only five starts. CONTILDA'S LOVE (9) drops back from Saturday company after making ground on heavy going at Eagle Farm, and his two wins from five starts at this track and distance are a major asset. POINT VEGA (1) returns over a pet trip and strips fitter for a trial win on the inner surface. Is a noted winner and has enough early speed to offset the wide draw. Can play a major role fresh. ACAPULCO GIRL (3) also resumes and looks up to the task with a trial win under her belt. Newman's claim also makes things a bit easier.
